{{Quote|We're on your tail, General Kenobi. Set S-foils to attack position.|"Odd Ball" Davijaan|<ref name="SWE3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Clone trooper pilots''' were special [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] bred in the [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] centers for the purpose of [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] crafts of the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]].

They first appeared at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], where they flew [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT/c]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]]. Pilots also operated [[CR20 troop carrier/Legends|CR20]] and [[CR25 troop carrier/Legends|CR25 troop carriers]]. In addition, they flew [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] such as the [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent]], [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]], and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing]]. The pilots who flew capital ships wore a special type of armor instead of the regular [[Phase II pilot armor/Legends|one]], seen in the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|First Battle of Mon Calamari]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Pilots also knew how to operate all military land vehicles such as the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]].

==History==
[[File:Clone_trooper_pilot.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Phase I clone pilot inside a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]]]
[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were born and raised in secret on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], starting from [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. They were [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and were purchased for use by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]] which demonstrated certain aptitudes were selected for pilot training.<ref name="Date 1" /> They first participated in battle [[22 BBY/Legends|ten]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after their creation at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] by piloting the Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunships]].<ref name="SWE2" /> During the course of the resulting conflict against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they also flew the [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing]] fighters that engaged Separatist forces in the depths of space or the skies of scattered worlds.<ref name="CW animation">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' animated tv-series</ref> Clone pilots would also occasionally participate in boarding parties, in orbital battles along with [[Clone marine]]s. In those engagements, clone pilots carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], [[F-187 fusioncutter]]s, and [[time bomb]]s to wreak havoc aboard enemy capital ships.<ref name="BF II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> During ground engagements, they carried [["DN bolt caster" plasma disruptor]]s and [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15Ss]], along with health and ammo dispensers with their fusioncutters to support their fellow clones.<ref name="BF I" />

The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] pilots participated in many battles throughout the war, piloting gunships to transport troopers and flying [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] to engage Separatist starfighters, especially in the early part of the war.<ref name="TCW">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> Wearing [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]] with yellow markings, they also piloted AT-TE walkers and other ground craft. Pilots participated in various campaigns, including the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|battles of Christophsis]], Teth, destroying the ''Malevolence'' at the Kaliida Nebula, Bothawui, Quell, Ryloth, Devaron, the Second Battle of Geonosis, and many others. They flew V-19s, Y-wing bombers, and ARC-170s for most of the early part of the war.

In late [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], clone pilot armor was changed with the addition of [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone armor]]. New clone Z-95 Headhunter starfighters were added to the Republic arsenal, and clone pilots flew them at battles including Umbara, Kadavo, Scipio, and many others. In mid [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the armor was changed yet again for some pilots, and the ARC-170 became the Republic's main starfighter, alongside new V-wings.

During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Squad Seven (Galactic Republic)|Squad Seven]], led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Davijaan/Legends|Davijaan]], was instrumental in holding off enemy forces and allowing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] infiltrate Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' fleeing [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], which subsequently led to the rescue of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="SWE3" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Want to borrow my armor? It's nice and white.|Unnamed [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], to [[Fi Skirata|Fi]], during a mission to [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Warthog_detail.png|thumb|150px|Clone trooper pilot Warthog in his customized Phase II helmet]]
These specialized troopers were normally equipped with a bolt caster, a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and a supply dispenser containing five packs of medicine, [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], and ammunition.<ref name="BF I" /> However, in space they discarded their bacta, ammo, and bolt casters for [[time bomb]]s.<ref name="BF II" />

===Armor===
When Phase I clone trooper armor was in use, ground and starfighter pilots wore armor that featured yellow markings and red Republic symbols on their specialized helmets.<ref name="SWE2" /> Phase I pilots also had a box attached to their chest armor that supplied oxygen to their helmets. This armor was in use until the introduction of Phase II armor in late 21 BBY. 

The pilots who flew [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] wore a special type of armor with a more angular helmet, as seen in the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Chapter 5 Star Wars: Clone Wars">{{CW|5}}</ref> The Republic's [[Stealth ship (Galactic Republic)/Legends|experimental stealth ship]] was piloted by specialized [[stealth pilot]]s, which wore a unique set of grey armor.<ref name="Cat and Mouse">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref>

New armor for the pilots was also added with Phase II armor. Those who wore Phase II pilot armor were also able to customize their armor.<ref name="TCW" /> As at that point Clone Z-95 starfighters were mainstream, they wore fully enclosed helmets like on the pilot in the picture on the above right. Later in mid 20 BBY, the armor was changed again to accommodate for the previously existing ARC-170 replacing the Z-95 as the mainstream starfighter.

Two sets of Phase II pilot armor were in use as of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date 2" /> The first set, which used a helmet that was not fully enclosed, was the more common set, as it was used by the majority of pilots.<ref name="SWE3" /> The second set, which had a fully enclosed helmet and armor that looked similar to that of an [[Vehicle Command Crewer|AT-AT pilot]], was mainly used in the V-wing starfighter, which carried no [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system and [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttles]].<ref name="RotS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

As part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], clone troopers who flew V-wing starfighters wore a set of armor consisting of a completely black [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] with a life support system and a black helmet similar to the ones worn by the earlier pilots of ARC-170 starfighters, but with parts of their face being exposed and and goggles covering their eyes.<ref name="Tin Collection">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|packtype=Commemorative Tin Collection|pack=Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (Exclusive Edition) (Clone Commander Cody, Anakin Skywalker, General Grievous. Clone Pilot)|altlink=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/content/modules.php?name=JReviews&rop=showcontent&id=1878}}</ref>

==Training==
Clone trooper pilots were randomly picked from the normal clone ranks to be pilots and technicians.<ref name="BF I guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> As the war progressed, a new breed of clones were trained to fly the latest Republic starfighters.<ref name="Charactesr">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> They could drive, fly, and pilot most things in the Republic's arsenal of vehicles, although many were trained to specialize in one particular craft.
